units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 59a:12">B. Kam. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>כַּחַשׁ גופנא</he> the weakening of the vine (by allowing the grapes to remain on it until they are ripe).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 101b:2">B. Mets. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>משום כ׳ דארעא</he> because he exhausted the soil by planting trees.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:12">Ib. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>מנכי ליה כ׳ דארעא</he> he must allow him a reduction of his rent in consideration of the lesser exhaustion of the soil (by having planted wheat in place of poppy).
